[line]
[font=Arial Black][color=#b6b6b6][size=5]What it Does [/size][/color][/font]
This mod changes the dinosaurs in the game into white ducks, because I wanted more ducks instead of lizards in my coop.

[line]
[font=Arial Black][color=#b6b6b6][size=5]Compatibility [/size][/color][/font]
any mod that edits the Dinosaur.xnb file will not work, all the changes are in this file however so as long as it doesn't do anything with that file, your good. 

Also its fully compatible with 1.0, 1.1, and theoretically any game version that doesn't edit this file, you will just need to reapply it after an update.

[line]
[font=Arial Black][color=#b6b6b6][size=5]Installation [/size][/color][/font]
Drag and drop the Dinosaur.xnb file in the Stardew Valley\Content\Animals directory.
MAKE SURE TO BACK UP YOUR Dinosaur.xnb  FILE! rename it Dinosaur.bak.xnb or move it somewhere, just save it.

Or use the Content patcher version and just put it into the mods folder

[line]
[font=Arial Black][color=#b6b6b6][size=5]Un-instillation [/size][/color][/font]
replace the Dinosaur.xnb file with the one you backed up. didn't back that file up? naughty naughty user, I'm afraid you now need to validate your stardew valley cache in steam, this means if you installed any more mods like this, that changes your cat to a Moogle, or makes your farm house bright pink, or makes your furniture look all witchy and cool, or makes fishing super easy mode (or anything that you don't put in your mods folder). you now need to re-install all of those as well.

or if you use the Content patcher version just delete the [CP] Dino Ducks mod
[line]
[font=Arial Black][color=#b6b6b6][size=5]Permissions [/size][/color][/font]
none, don't re-upload anywhere, please.
